caseNameFull: Beal, Secretary, Department of Public Welfare of Pennsylvania v. Broderick, U. S. District Judge

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Application for stay of participation of the United States in Halderman v. Pennhurst, C. A. No. 74-1345 (ED Pa.), presented to Mr. Justice Rehnquist, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.
